title: 回転式の屋外物干し
description: 共同住宅の中庭や住宅の庭に設置する開いた状態の回転物干し。支柱、可動を模した上下ハブ、4本の腕と支え、6周の実ジオメトリ物干し紐を造形。洗濯物、地面、回転・折畳み・紐のシミュレーションは含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.947 × 2.070 × 1.947 m、6,176三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An open rotary clothesline for residential or shared courtyards, with a mast, upper/sliding hubs, four arms and support stays, and six actual geometry clothesline circuits. Laundry, ground, rotation, folding and line simulation are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.947 × 2.070 × 1.947 m; 6,176 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
